```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)

# Blue ramp (light -> dark) for depth: one hue, one job
depth_ramp <- c("#86b6ef", "#3987e5", "#256abf", "#184f95", "#0d366b")
ink        <- "#0b0b0b"
grid       <- "#e1e0d9"
accent     <- "#2a78d6"

q <- quakes |>
  mutate(
    tip = sprintf("Magnitude %.1f<br>Depth %d km<br>%d stations reported",
                  mag, depth, stations)
  )

deep_share <- round(100 * mean(q$depth > 300))
r_ms       <- round(cor(q$mag, q$stations), 2)

# the central band where the deep quakes pile up
core       <- q$long >= 178 & q$long <= 182
core_n     <- sum(core)
core_med   <- median(q$depth[core])
edge_med   <- median(q$depth[!core])

font <- list(family = "system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif", color = ink)
cfg  <- function(p) config(p, displaylogo = FALSE,
                           modeBarButtonsToRemove = c("select2d", "lasso2d"))
```

## The data

<div class="stats">
  <div class="stat"><div class="n">`r format(nrow(q), big.mark = ",")`</div><div class="l">earthquakes near Fiji, 1964 onward</div></div>
  <div class="stat"><div class="n">`r min(q$mag)`–`r max(q$mag)`</div><div class="l">Richter magnitude</div></div>
  <div class="stat"><div class="n">`r min(q$depth)`–`r max(q$depth)` km</div><div class="l">depth below the surface</div></div>
</div>

R ships this as the built-in `quakes` data set. Every row is one event with its
position, depth, magnitude and the number of stations that detected it.

Everything after this slide is interactive: **hover** for details, **drag** to
pan or rotate, **scroll** to zoom.

## Where the quakes happened

::: {.split}
::: {.chart}
```{r map, fig.width=5.8}
plot_geo(q, lat = ~lat, lon = ~long) |>
  add_markers(
    color = ~depth, colors = depth_ramp,
    text = ~tip, hoverinfo = "text",
    marker = list(size = 6, opacity = 0.85,
                  line = list(color = "#fcfcfb", width = 1)),
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) |>
  colorbar(title = "Depth (km)", len = 0.7, thickness = 12) |>
  layout(
    font = font, height = 420, margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 0, b = 0),
    geo = list(
      resolution = 50,
      projection = list(type = "mercator", rotation = list(lon = 180)),
      lonaxis = list(range = c(160, 195)), lataxis = list(range = c(-42, -8)),
      showland = TRUE, landcolor = "#ecebe6", showocean = TRUE,
      oceancolor = "#f6f7f9", showcountries = TRUE, countrycolor = "#c3c2b7",
      coastlinecolor = "#a9a8a0", bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
    )
  ) |>
  cfg()
```
:::
::: {.text}
**What to notice**

- <span class="dot shallow"></span> **Light blue** quakes are shallow. They trace the edges: a western arc and a long southeast arc.
- <span class="dot deep"></span> **Dark blue** quakes are deep. They crowd into a band near 180°E, right under Fiji.
- Hover any dot for its magnitude, depth and station count.
:::
:::

## A plate, seen from the side

```{r three-d}
plot_ly(q, x = ~long, y = ~lat, z = ~(-depth),
        type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers",
        text = ~tip, hoverinfo = "text",
        marker = list(
          size = 3, opacity = 0.9,
          color = ~depth, colorscale = Map(list, seq(0, 1, length.out = 5), depth_ramp),
          colorbar = list(title = "Depth (km)", len = 0.6),
          line = list(width = 0)
        ),
        height = 410) |>
  layout(
    font = font, margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 0, b = 0),
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "Longitude", gridcolor = grid),
      yaxis = list(title = "Latitude",  gridcolor = grid),
      zaxis = list(title = "Depth (km)", gridcolor = grid,
                   tickvals = c(0, -200, -400, -600), ticktext = c(0, 200, 400, 600)),
      camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.15, y = -1.25, z = 0.45)),
      aspectratio = list(x = 1, y = 1.1, z = 0.7)
    )
  ) |>
  cfg()
```

<p class="cap">Drag to rotate. Light quakes spread across the top; the dark deep ones
form a column rising from the floor of the plot.</p>

## Two families of earthquakes

```{r depth-hist}
plot_ly(q, x = ~depth, type = "histogram",
        xbins = list(start = 0, end = 700, size = 25),
        marker = list(color = accent, line = list(color = "#fcfcfb", width = 2)),
        hovertemplate = "%{x} km: %{y} quakes<extra></extra>",
        height = 400) |>
  layout(
    font = font, bargap = 0,
    xaxis = list(title = "Depth (km)", gridcolor = grid, zeroline = FALSE),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of quakes", gridcolor = grid, zeroline = FALSE),
    margin = list(t = 10, r = 10)
  ) |>
  cfg()
```

<p class="cap">`r deep_share`% of the quakes are deeper than 300 km, yet few sit
in between. Most are either shallow or very deep.</p>

## Bigger quakes, more stations

```{r mag-stations}
fit  <- lm(stations ~ mag, data = q)
line <- data.frame(mag = range(q$mag))
line$stations <- predict(fit, line)

plot_ly(height = 400) |>
  add_markers(data = q, x = ~jitter(mag, amount = 0.03), y = ~stations,
              text = ~tip, hoverinfo = "text", name = "Earthquake",
              marker = list(color = accent, size = 7, opacity = 0.45,
                            line = list(color = "#fcfcfb", width = 1))) |>
  add_lines(data = line, x = ~mag, y = ~stations, name = "Linear fit",
            line = list(color = ink, width = 2), hoverinfo = "skip") |>
  layout(
    font = font,
    xaxis = list(title = "Magnitude", gridcolor = grid, zeroline = FALSE),
    yaxis = list(title = "Stations that detected it", gridcolor = grid, zeroline = FALSE),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.1),
    margin = list(t = 10, r = 10)
  ) |>
  cfg()
```

<p class="cap">Correlation r = `r r_ms`. A stronger quake is picked up by more instruments.
(Points are nudged sideways slightly so the 0.1-magnitude columns don't overlap.)</p>

## Takeaways

- Quakes between 178°E and 182°E (`r core_n` of them) have a median depth of
  **`r core_med` km**. Everywhere else it is **`r edge_med` km**.
- Depth is **two-humped**: `r deep_share`% of events are deeper than 300 km, with a thin middle.
- Magnitude tracks how many **stations** pick up an event (r = `r r_ms`).
- Built with **R Markdown** (`ioslides`) and **Plotly**, from R's built-in `quakes` data.
